confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated Philippine and Siargao cost-of-living and listing data. Most sources are crowd-sourced, some are undated, and they disagree somewhat, so restaurant and beer anchors are medium confidence. Cocktail and wine_glass are less certain: no Siargao-specific aggregate was found, so they are bounded using the beer relationship and national bottle-price references. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Siargao's General Luna and Cloud 9 lodging market for a July (low-season) window. No booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX value (0.6720 USD per AUD, 2026-11-18) was taken from search-result text describing the RBA exchange rates page; the RBA table itself was not opened in full, and an earlier search returned older, conflicting values. Verify it on rba.gov.au before use. Two RBA-directed searches were used, not one.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable city. Food and drink are benchmarked to Philippine tourist-town and national aggregates, including Siargao-specific cost-of-living pages, with Siargao placed below Boracay and roughly at Coron/El Nido levels. Accommodation is a holistic estimate relative to other Philippine island beach destinations, without inspection of live listings.
